title: Shadow of Menzoberranzan
summary: Light Armour helmet grants two turns of invisibility once per Short Rest.

fields.Shrouded in Shadow: Action on yourself. Concentrate to become Invisible for up to 2 turns. Ends early when you attack, cast, take an action, or take damage. Once per Short Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Near Xargrim in the secret area unlocked by Defeat the Duergar Intruders.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
